## Summary

What changed, why, and what is intentionally out of scope?

## Related issue

Link the issue. Use `Closes #...` only if this PR meets its acceptance criteria.

## Evidence

Describe the minimal failure trace or documentation rationale. List applicable
commands run and any checks skipped, with reasons. Use synthetic data only.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I connected the issue's acceptance criteria to evidence and disclosed unrun checks.
- [ ] Any API, schema, dependency, or experimental-contract change was discussed first.
- [ ] New or fixed behavior has focused regression coverage, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] Intent binding, unresolved scope blocking, and read-only recovery are preserved.
- [ ] Claims match the observed evidence and do not imply exactly-once execution or provider certification.
- [ ] No credentials, private journals, real receipts, or personal data are included.
